paths.name: @mui/material
paths.message: Don't import @mui/material directly in src/containers/**. Use a shared component from src/components/UI (see src/components/UI/README.md) or, if it genuinely doesn't exist yet, add it there instead of inlining MUI here.

patterns.message: Don't import @mui/material/* directly in src/containers/**. Use a shared component from src/components/UI (see src/components/UI/README.md) or, if it genuinely doesn't exist yet, add it there instead of inlining MUI here.
